subject: Request: executive sign-off for one-off account adjustment - Weston Health
messages:
From: Emily White <emily.white@westonhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Production impact 11/11 - request for remediation & commercial offset

Hi Priya / Marissa,

We had a significant degradation in request throughput and increased latency during our busiest window on 11/11 (see attached incident timeline). From 11:03–11:47 our inference latency spiked above the 95th percentile SLOs and two failover attempts added additional delay to our job queue. The result: several downstream jobs timed out and the clinical notification pipeline delayed non-urgent alerts.

This is directly material to our go-live plans. Per our contract (SLA section 3.2) we expect an availability/latency makewhole for incidents that impact scheduled production windows. Weston requests:
- A commercial offset to cover the operational impact (we propose 2 months of service credit or an equivalent one-time payment), and
- Confirmation of the RCA and a commitment on mitigations before we resume ramping traffic.

Please advise next steps and who needs to sign the settlement. We need to close this by the end of next week to avoid delaying our rollout.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily White
Director of Platform Engineering
Weston Health

Attachment: weston_incident_timeline.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:15:12 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Production impact 11/11 - request for remediation & commercial offset

Team — forwarding Weston’s ask. Key facts: WD-8877, committed capacity plan in force; customer experienced elevated p95 latency and partial throughput loss during peak for ~44 minutes. Customer is asking for a commercial offset (2 months or equivalent). They want RCA and mitigations before resuming ramp.

Options I see (please propose exact numbers + approval path):
A) One-time credit equal to 2 months of committed spend (approx $48k)
B) 1 month credit + $15k goodwill one-time credit
C) Technical remediation + smaller credit + free onboarding credits for next month (to reduce churn risk)

We’ll need exec approval for any option > $20k. Laura, can you add legal language required to close? Karthik — need your guidance on precedent and whether we should offer a partial refund or pure service credit.

Attaching the incident timeline and draft RCA (internal). I’ll coordinate with Emily on DocuSign once terms are final.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: weston_incident_timeline.pdf, rca-draft.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:05:30 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production impact 11/11 - request for remediation & commercial offset

Agree we should be pragmatic here — customer sentiment is fragile given the rollout. My recommendation (balanced for retention + precedent):
- Offer: 1 month committed-capacity credit + $12,000 one-time service credit (total ~$30k value).
- Require: acceptance of RCA and a 30-day remediation plan submission; commit to a joint operations call and a follow-up health check.

Rationale: 2 months (~$48k) is doable but sets a high public precedent. 1 month + a moderate one-time credit shows we’re taking it seriously while keeping the door open to escalate to an executive concession if they remain unsatisfied after remediation.

If you want to push to $48k, we need explicit signoff from Karthik / CRO; otherwise, I can own the customer conversation for the $30k package.

—Marissa
Head, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 16:40:05 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production impact 11/11 - request for remediation & commercial offset

Quick legal note on settlement mechanics:
- Any commercial concession should be documented in a short settlement agreement that amends the existing Master Services Agreement; attach a one-paragraph waiver that: (1) releases Redwood from additional claims arising out of the 11/11 incident once signed, and (2) requires the customer to confirm acceptance of the RCA and remediation plan.
- Do not include language that acts as a precedent across other accounts — keep it account-specific and time-limited.
- We should route for DocuSign and include an approvals box for Finance code allocation and GL posting.

I’ve attached a draft settlement_terms_draft.pdf with suggested language. Also note: if we commit to a cash refund instead of credit, we need VP Finance approval; service credits can be booked against promotional allowances.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:30:22 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Production impact 11/11 - request for remediation & commercial offset

I’m comfortable approving a one-time concession in this case but want to limit precedent. Final call: offer the $12k one-time credit + 1 month committed-capacity credit (Marissa’s proposal) AND include two technical credits for professional services (up to $5k) to help with the remediation. Total commercial value ~ $35k.

Requirements before signature:
- Customer signs the settlement and acknowledges the RCA / remediation plan (DocuSign).
- Settlement explicitly marked account-specific and non-precedential.
- Finance to confirm booking code: Promo-OP-2026 and confirm GL impact. Priya, please submit the credit_calculation.xlsx to Finance and loop in accounting.

Priya — you have exec sign-off from me. Please proceed to finalize terms with Laura’s language and send to Weston with DocuSign link. Keep me posted if they push for cash.

Karthik
VP, Sales (Americas)
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily White <emily.white@westonhealth.com>, Chad Hanlon <chad.hanlon@westonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Settlement offer and next steps — Weston Health (WD-8877)

Hi Emily / Chad,

Thank you again for patience while we investigated. We own the production impact and want to resolve this quickly so you can proceed with your rollout. Per internal review, Redwood is prepared to offer the following settlement package:

- Commercial: 1 month of committed-capacity credit (applies to your existing committed plan) + $12,000 one-time service credit.
- Technical: Up to $5,000 in professional services credits to support remediation and a joint ops call within 5 business days.
- Conditions: Acceptance of the attached RCA and a 30-day remediation plan; settlement requires signature of the attached agreement which includes a limited release specific to the 11/11 incident.

I’ve attached the settlement_terms_draft.pdf and the settlement_agreement.pdf for signature. Please sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/redsigned/ZX-4498. Once signed we’ll apply the credits within two billing cycles and schedule the remediation kick-off.

If you prefer a cash adjustment instead of service credit, let me know; that would require additional approvals and a slightly longer timeline.

Appreciate the partnership — I’ll hold a tentative slot for a technical call next Tuesday.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: settlement_terms_draft.pdf, settlement_agreement.pdf
Related links: https://drive.redwood/Weston/RCA-20261114, https://docusign.com/redsigned/ZX-4498
